# Story 8.1: Copied from another epic

## Story

As a fixture author,
I want a file named for story 7.1 whose heading says 8.1,
so that a copied-and-renamed artifact cannot silently donate its criteria.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Given** a file named 7.1 whose heading claims 8.1
   **When** the epic is ingested
   **Then** ingestion refuses instead of attributing these criteria to 7.1.
